subject: software-engineering
intro: Software engineering leads to the people who build and run the world's code — specifying, designing, testing and shipping the systems everything else depends on.

roles.title: Software Developers
roles.what: Research, design and develop computer and network software or specialised utility programs — analysing user needs and building software solutions with the principles and techniques of computer science, engineering and mathematical analysis.
roles.where: Requirements elicitation, design patterns and architecture styles, construction practices, API design and version control are literally the SWEBOK units you study here, applied to real products and codebases.

roles.title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
roles.what: Develop and execute software tests to identify problems and their causes, document defects in tracking systems, and take part in design reviews to improve functional requirements, operational characteristics and product designs.
roles.where: The testing and quality unit — test levels and the pyramid, coverage and test design, static analysis — is the craft itself, while requirements specification teaches you what a correct system should do in the first place.

roles.title: Computer Systems Analysts
roles.what: Analyse science, engineering and business data-processing problems and design solutions — improving existing computer systems, reviewing capabilities, workflow and schedule limits, and recommending software and hardware.
roles.where: Requirements elicitation and stakeholder analysis, non-functional requirements, and the process unit with estimation, planning and risk management give you the modelling and communication habits analysts trade in.

roles.title: Computer and Information Systems Managers
roles.entry: Bachelor's degree plus years of experience
roles.what: Plan, direct and coordinate activities in electronic data processing, information systems, systems analysis and computer programming — usually after years as a developer or analyst, now owning budgets, teams and delivery.
roles.where: Process models and project management — agile and lean, estimation, risk — plus the security, ethics and professional practice unit prepare the oversight half of the job, with design and construction keeping the technical judgement credible.
